lines.text: If you need anything, just give me a shout.
What a nice day for jogging.
Hey Partner, how about sharing a nice cup of joe with me? Plenty of sugar, of course!
A kiss with a coffee aftertaste... I can see myself getting addicted to that. How about you?
This place is dullsville. How about we go for a ride on my motorcycle?
I don't mind what the mission is as long as it's with you, Partner.
*Sigh...* How long are you gonna keep me waiting?
I'll get myself a cup of coffee. Take your time.
I really dig this place. It's perfect for jogging.
Have you been to the cafe? The coffee there is spectacular. They don't skimp on the sugar!
This cafe would be perfect if it weren't for those two weirdoes.
What have you got for me this time, Partner?
I can jog for a bit longer.
Don't worry. The power belongs to you, Partner.
Since we are upgrading, I would appreciate it if you can upgrade more.
Thank you, I'm sure this will come in handy.
This is expensive! I'll pay you back with my equally expensive kiss.
Your next request is on the house!
We've become closer... Sounds weird when I put it like that.
You're full-bodied and sweet, just like a cup of sugar coffee.
I think I'm addicted to you, Partner. I want another taste.
Let's go.
What's next?
Let's go, Black Typhoon. Whoosh!
Let's get down to business.
Request difficulty: Medium.
Let's go.
How quickly should I wrap this all up?
Reloading, cover me!
Current ammo is sufficient.
No attacking while I'm reloading!
Partner!
Playtime's over. Take this!
Let's show them how we roll.
Good shot.
One point for me.
Clear.
Ow!
*Grunt*
*Gasp*
I've got low blood sugar... What else can I do?
Request cleared.
Fighting in a bunny girl outfit... This is a rather unusual assignment.
Riding in this outfit honestly ain't that bad.
Ever wonder what coffee made by a bunny girl would taste like? For starters, it'd be loaded with sugar.
I bet a kiss in this outfit would taste different from usual. Whaddya think, Partner? Wanna find out?
I'll take on an assignment from you any day, Partner. And today, I'll give you everything I've got.
You've never ridden a bike with a bunny girl before, have you, Partner? What do you say, wanna give it a try today?
Do I just keep waiting here like this?
I'll be here sippin' on my coffee, so feel free to do whatever you need to do.
Don't worry. I won't stir up any trouble here.
If it's an assignment from you, Partner, I'm always in.
If I ride around in this outfit, everyone's gonna stare... That sounds pretty exhilarating.
Guess there are assignments that require me to become a bunny girl. Well, no big deal.
The next assignment will be a cinch.
Think you can keep up with me, Partner?
Sweet. Now I can shake things up even more than before.
A perfect gift for a bunny girl. Thank you.
I got you something in return. Here, it's a carrot.
This'll come in handy whenever I need to stir up some trouble.
Wanna celebrate this with a proper kiss?
This is bad. Whenever you're by my side, I find myself wanting to stir up even bigger trouble.
Who knew we could grow even closer? Maybe our bond is deeper than I thought.
I'll show you what bunny girls can do.
Is it another assignment?
Where are we going this time?
So I just have to go all out, right?
This assignment should be a breeze.
So this is my mission as a bunny girl? Fine by me.
Let's do this, Partner.
I'll put an end to this soon.
Enjoying the view from back there?
With you around, Partner, I can let my guard down a little.
This bunny's locked and loaded.
Time to go full throttle!
Let's get this over with!
So it's true, bunnies bring good luck...
That was easy.
Pretty wild for a bunny girl, huh?
Ugh!
Oof!
Argh...!
Maybe the outfit was too restrictive...
Did you enjoy working this assignment with a bunny girl, Partner?

favorite.name: Commemorative Keychain
favorite.description:
Each new charm added to this keychain marks another moment worth remembering.
They may look strange to everyone else, but to the two who share those memories, they're beyond precious.
